title: SEC Adds Tokenization to Fiscal 2027 Examination Priorities
description: The SEC's Division of Examinations will scrutinize tokenization at clearing agencies and Regulation SCI entities as part of its risk-based fiscal 2027 program.
why_it_matters: Tokenization is moving from a policy experiment into the SEC's recurring supervisory work, raising the compliance stakes for market infrastructure that records, clears or operates tokenized securities.
keyTakeaways: The SEC named tokenization among fiscal 2027 risks associated with evolving market infrastructure.
Clearing-agency examinations will cover tokenization alongside operations, securities lending and default-risk controls.
Regulation SCI reviews will examine tokenized securities together with extended trading hours and other technology trends.
body:
The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission added tokenization to the Division of Examinations' fiscal 2027 priorities on October 23. The annual plan guides a risk-based program covering more than 34,000 registrants, but the SEC says it is not an exhaustive list of examination topics.

Tokenization appears in two market-infrastructure areas. Examinations of clearing agencies will review it alongside operations, securities lending, default management, recovery and wind-down. Reviews under Regulation Systems Compliance and Integrity will also focus on tokenized securities, extended trading hours, advanced computing and technology-vendor risk.

The document does not announce a new rule or enforcement action. It signals where examiners expect heightened operational, governance and investor-protection risks as regulated firms adopt tokenized securities infrastructure.

sources.name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — FY 2027 Examination Priorities
U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — Press Release 2026-109

facts.claim: The examination program covers more than 34,000 SEC registrants across multiple regulated market-participant categories.
The SEC identified tokenization as a risk associated with evolving market infrastructure.
Clearing-agency examinations will include tokenization among several operational and risk-management focus areas.
Regulation SCI examinations will focus on tokenized securities and extended trading hours among emerging trends.
facts.anchor: tokenization of securities, extended trading hours

facts.claim: The SEC said its published fiscal 2027 priorities do not exhaust all matters examiners may review.
